items.title: Costco (COST) Is Running A Florida Distribution Center Fully Off The Grid
items.summary: Costco Wholesale has begun operating its Port St. Lucie, Florida distribution center fully off the power grid. The facility now runs on an on-site solar and battery energy system in partnership with Trinity Energy. This move aligns the site with Costco's broader net zero and sustainability objectives.
